senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. pl. Shushan, Susa, the capital of the Persian empire; שׁ׳ הַבִּירָה the Castle of S.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Middot 1:3">Midd. I, 3</cite> <he>שער המזרחי עליו ש׳ הב׳ צורה</he> the eastern gate of the Temple mount on which the picture of the Castle of S. was sculptured.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 17:9">Kel. XVII, 9</cite> <he>שתי אמות בש׳ הב׳</he> two standard cubit measures were deposited in the gate called the Castle of S.; <cite ref="Menachot 98a:9">Men. 98ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bekhorot 39b">Bekh. 39ᵇ</cite> sq.; <cite ref="Pesachim 86a">Pes. 86ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Megillah 2b:14">Meg. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>מה ש׳ מוקפת וכ׳</he> as S. was known to be a fortified city since the days of Ahasverus &c.
<cite ref="Megillah 2b:20">Ib.</cite> <he>לחלק בין ש׳ וכ׳</he> to make a distinction between S. and other towns; a. fr.
